description: def get5 = 5 really returns an Int and running get5() is completely safe -- the *program* is fine. What must never validate is *this certificate*: it claims get5's return type is an instance of String, which its own body (claimed as arrow_of([], Int) would be, if honest) contradicts. A cert whose own claims are mutually inconsistent must be rejected regardless of whether a different, honest cert for the same program would validate -- otherwise the certificate mechanism itself is meaningless. Permanent negative target for this specific cert.
